name: MiniDonut
description: A ring of segments, each drawn as its share of the whole — so the values need no total, and the colours cycle through the six a `ChartContainer` declares.

props.name: data
props.description: One value per segment. Each is drawn as its share of the whole, so they need no total.

props.name: colors
props.description: One colour per segment, cycled if there are fewer than there are values.

props.name: thickness
props.description: The width of the ring in view units, out of the 100 the box is wide.

a11y: `aria-hidden` with no `label`, and a `label` makes it `role="img"`. Segments are told apart by colour alone, so the breakdown has to exist somewhere a reader can get at it.
